note: Only skills verified installed on the operator's Mac (ls ~/.claude/skills ~/.codex/skills + the enabled nateherk-design plugin). test_idea_wheel.py re-checks every name against disk. Skills that call paid generation APIs (Higgsfield, kie.ai) are flagged 'paid' and need the operator's go before any generation.

claude.invoke: Claude Code: invoke with the Skill tool by name (plugin skills as plugin:name).

core.name: impeccable
core.when: Before building any page: shape the layout, then audit and polish the finished UI (critique, harden, adapt for mobile).
core.notFor: Writing data models, logic or tests.

core.name: taste-skill
core.when: While writing page composition and components: enforces spacing, type scale and component discipline so the result does not look like a default AI page.
core.notFor: Visual asset production (that is Codex's lane) or copywriting.

core.name: high-end-visual-design
core.when: Setting the type, spacing and card system in CONTRACT.md tokens so the concept reads premium.
core.notFor: Calm or accessibility-first concepts where restraint matters more than polish tricks; never as a reason to add decoration.

core.name: scroll-craft
core.when: Planning the visitor journey, the emotional peak and the one signature scroll move, plus its desktop / mobile / reduced-motion verification.
core.notFor: Generating photoreal assets through kie.ai without the operator's go; use supplied or placeholder imagery by default.

core.name: scroll-world
core.when: Only for a showcase concept that wants a full scroll-scrubbed 'fly through the world' hero.
core.notFor: Booking, quote or calm concepts, app-like tools, and any run where Higgsfield generation is not approved by the operator.

skills.name: soft-skill
skills.when: Premium soft aesthetics: refined type pairing, soft shadows, generous whitespace.

skills.name: minimalist-ui
skills.when: Clean editorial interfaces: warm monochrome, typographic contrast, flat bento grids.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.when: Friendly or playful directions that still need metric-based discipline.

skills.name: brutalist-skill
skills.when: Raw Swiss-print / terminal aesthetics with extreme type contrast.
skills.notFor: Care, health, legal or finance concepts.

skills.name: industrial-brutalist-ui
skills.when: Utilitarian industrial interfaces: rigid grids, mechanical labels.

app.name: expo-router
app.when: Setting up the companion app's file-based routes, tabs and stacks.

app.name: expo-native-ui
app.when: Making the companion app's screens feel native (HIG spacing, semantic colours, native controls).

app.name: expo-animation
app.when: Building the app's signature gesture and its spring / timing decisions.

app.name: expo-ui
app.when: Native sheets, pickers, toggles and menus via @expo/ui.

reel.name: hyperframes
reel.when: Rendering the portfolio demo reel from the content kit storyboard (HTML-to-video).

reel.name: app-showcase-video
reel.when: After the companion app runs in the iOS simulator: a vertical promo with the real recording inside a phone frame.

codex.invoke: Codex: name the skill in the task (skills live in ~/.codex/skills).

core.name: frontend-design
core.when: Building the ui/components set against CONTRACT.md with a distinctive, production-grade look.
core.notFor: Changing copy, data shapes or page logic.

core.name: ui-ux-pro-max
core.when: Picking concrete type pairings, spacing scales and component states that match the contract's aesthetic.
core.notFor: Overriding the palette or tokens Claude fixed in CONTRACT.md.

core.name: scroll-craft
core.when: Implementing the Design DNA mechanic in ui/motion/ with its reduced-motion and mobile variants, then checking all three visually.
core.notFor: kie.ai asset generation without the operator's go.

core.name: impeccable
core.when: Final polish pass on ui/: focus states, contrast, responsive breakpoints, motion audit.

app.name: expo-native-ui
app.when: Styling the companion app screens once Claude has the routes and data in place.

app.name: expo-animation
app.when: Polishing the app's signature gesture animation.
